evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the 7B chat model is competitive with GPT-3.5 on four of five evaluated tasks, despite its relatively small size.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: base language model not advised for direct text generation; without post-training it is likely to produce ungrounded or fabricated text

specifications.model_size: 14.4 GiB of safetensors weights (15,442,693,552 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a base language model and is not advised for direct text generation; post-training such as SFT, RLHF, or continued pretraining is recommended before use.
